verdict.rationale: Airweave ingests data from apps, databases, cloud drives, and SaaS tools (not chat transcripts) via source connections into collections, and supports search over documents/JSON/business data via vector or agentic search. Community feedback corroborates real-world use for unifying multiple heterogeneous sources into a searchable layer. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of raw JSON upload/ingestion API details or file-format specifics, and no independent benchmark of document-type coverage beyond connector list.
